title: Government Agricultural Schemes, Eligibility, and Application Procedures
source_name: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI & Dept of Agriculture Govt of Maharashtra
summary: Key financial support schemes for farmers: PM-KISAN, Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi, PMFBY 1 Rupee Crop Insurance, MahaDBT Subsidies, PoCRA.
content: 1) PM-KISAN & Namo Shetkari Nidhi: Provides ₹6,000/year (central) in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 directly via DBT into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts. Maharashtra farmers receive an additional ₹6,000/year under Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi, totaling ₹12,000/year. Eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land in 7/12 extract, e-KYC completed via OTP or biometric, land seeding verified. Exclusions: Institutional landholders, income tax payees, constitutional post holders, retired pensioners above ₹10,000/month. 2) PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY @ ₹1 in Maharashtra): Farmers in Maharashtra pay only ₹1 premium per application, with remaining premium borne by State & Central Govt. Covers localized calamities, unseasonal rainfall, mid-season adversity, and post-harvest losses within 14 days of harvest. Claim Intimation: Must report damage within 72 hours on Crop Insurance App or toll-free 14447 or to local Taluka Krishi Adhikari. 3) MahaDBT Farmer Portal (mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in): Single lottery portal for farm mechanization (tractors, rotavators 40-50% subsidy), drip/sprinkler systems (55% subsidy), farm ponds (₹50,000-₹75,000 subsidy), and shade net houses. Required Documents: Aadhaar card, 7/12 & 8A land records, bank passbook, self-declaration, caste certificate (for SC/ST higher subsidy).
